follow-up time: 12 months pre and post OMBU implementation
exposure: primary care onsite midwife-led birth units (OMBUs)
cohort: Pregnant women giving birth at Frere Maternity Hospital
finding: After the OMBU opened, the total number of births increased, births in the obstetric unit decreased, and maternal and perinatal deaths were lower, although these improvements cannot be definitively attributed to the OMBU.
mod_finding: The study found a decrease in the total number of births in the hospital obstetric unit after the opening of an onsite midwife-led birth unit, suggesting a potential shift in mode of delivery for some women.
